title: Custom resource issues related to GDS implementation of `get_global_class_name`
body:
### Tested versions

v4.6.dev.custom_build [22a28e07c]

### System information

Fedora 41

### Issue description

While reviewing https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/112923 both myself and @Ivorforce had some doubts about the current implementation of `get_global_class_names`. This issue derives some actual user facing issues from the code. See repro steps for details.

### Steps to reproduce

Open the MRP and try to create instances of the different resources in the project. For some of them the editor won't recognize them as Resources.

The happy case is in the folder `unnamed_intermediate`. A named resource that extends from the absolute path of an unnamed resource is correctly picked up. On the other side those edge cases are not recognized as Resource:

- [ ] `named_extended_by_path`. Both resources are recognized as `Resource` and can be created through the file system dock. However `NEP_Res2` is not recognized as subclass of `NEP_Res1`. It can not be created through the inspector when `NEP_Res1` is exported. (This is the issue you were talking about earlier on RC I think @Ivorforce)
- [x] `extended_by_relative_path`. `REL_Res2` is not recognized as `Resource` and can not be created. (Fixed by https://github.com/godotengine/godot/pull/104014)
- [ ] `extend_inner`. `IN_Res1` is not recognized as `Resource` and can not be created. (https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/15144 would fix this I guess.)


### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[get-global-class-name.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23751596/get-global-class-name.zip)
